duels.note: Thirteen non-self unordered pairs use two orientations; two self pairs use one physical configuration and both score columns.

analysisPlan.metric: Team points per candidate appearance, not battle win percentage.
analysisPlan.populationUnit: Twenty sampled opponent sets per K, each averaging both candidate-name orientations and all ten wars.
analysisPlan.duelUnit: Eight engine-seed blocks per logical matchup, each averaging both name orientations.
analysisPlan.densityChange: Scenario5 minus scenario0 uses coefficients [p0-1,p1,p2,p3] on independent K strata, not independent-scenario variance.
analysisPlan.claim: Complete descriptive stress results only. Nominal approximate intervals, not familywise promotion tests, universal superiority, or immunity.

randomness.provenance: Single post-review crypto draw: one 32-byte salt, 80 population and eight duel 12-byte seed suffixes. No automatic redraw or outcome access.
